title: The 1st Album
scene: West German Eurodisco / synth-pop, Hamburg Hansa studios
notes: Warm tenor, high falsetto choruses and glittering keyboard-pop shaped the breakthrough hits.

title: Let's Talk About Love
notes: Cheri Cheri Lady anchors streamlined romantic disco-pop with repeated falsetto responses.

title: Ready for Romance
notes: Brother Louie and Atlantis drive compact choruses over romantic, dance-oriented pop arrangements.

title: In the Middle of Nowhere
notes: Geronimo’s Cadillac leads polished disco-pop alongside gentler, peace-minded ballads.
